title: Zenon archive: P.Cair.Zen. I–V (Edgar, Zenon Papyri, 1925–31); RU «Архив Зенона»
author: Zenon of Kaunos, Apollonios the dioiketes and their correspondents
size: P.Cair.Zen.: 822 HGV records. Related sets: P.Lond. VII 261, P.Mich. I 111, PSI IV–VI 376 records
edition: C. C. Edgar, Catalogue général du Caire (1925–31): Greek text with English summaries and notes but no translations (OCR check of vol. II). Public-domain scans on archive.org; digital text on papyri.info (CC).
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka finds studies only (e.g., on Ptolemaic officials, 2019). HGV metadata records zero Russian translations across 68,022 papyri.
en_evidence: My HGV computation: 146 of 822 P.Cair.Zen. texts list any translation, 14 hosted on papyri.info. By contrast P.Mich. I (Edgar 1931) is fully translated (111/111).
other_translations: Scattered DE/FR/IT items among the 146 (HGV); no systematic translation
value: The richest archive of early Ptolemaic Egypt: the Philadelphia gift estate, Greek settlers, agriculture, taxation, trade with Syria-Palestine, everyday letters. A staple of Hellenistic history teaching, yet about 80% of the Cairo texts have no translation in any language.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: koine prose with machine-readable text, and Edgar's summaries help. Risks: abbreviations, accounts, fragmentary letters, technical vocabulary.
pilot_unit: P.Cair.Zen. II (nos. 59140–59297; 158 numbers, 1926), est. 15–20k Greek words
